newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia trade surplus down 69 percent in Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia trade surplus down 69 percent in Jan-Aug.

text.p: Mongolia's trade surplus fell 69 percent in the first eight months of 1996 to $22.2 million, down from $71.5 million in the same period last year, according to official statistics released on Thursday.
Imports soared 24 percent to $282.2 million, up from $227.6 million in the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Exports increased 1.8 percent to $304.4 million, compared with $299.1 million a year earlier.
The trade deficit for August alone was $3.5 million, compared with a $6.0 million surplus in August, 1995, the figures showed.
Exports in August rose to $32.7 million from $32.4 million a year earlier, while imports soared to $36.2 million, from $26.4 million in the year-ago month, the statistics showed.
